PS-HC01.punch: Enna Koduma Saravanan Idhu?! Symptom-ah paathu bayamuruthuna hospital bill-ah paathu bayapadanum!
constraints: Must not hallucinate dangerous diagnoses; triage priority levels (Low, Moderate, Emergency) must be clear.
Avoid definitive diagnoses and unsafe treatment recommendations.
Request additional information when symptoms are incomplete or contradictory.
Prioritize critical warning signs and recommend immediate medical attention when necessary.
Protect sensitive patient information through encryption and access controls.
Ground recommendations in trusted medical guidelines.

PS-HC02.punch: Appa tablet-ah potengala? Illa da marandhutten! - Idhukku dhaan da indha app!
constraints: Identify clinically significant drug-drug and drug-allergy conflicts.
Track medication schedules, missed doses, and duplicate entries reliably.
Generate critical medication safety alerts within 2 seconds of processing new information.
Never independently modify prescribed dosages or recommend unsafe compensatory doses.
Secure prescriptions and patient records using encryption and access controls.
Use verified medication databases and up-to-date safety information.

PS-HC03.punch: Body soda buddi maadhiri aayiruchu... Enna thalaiva health tracking start pannalama?
constraints: Process incoming sensor readings with minimal delay.
Handle intermittent connectivity, incomplete readings, and sensor failures.
Minimize unnecessary health warnings caused by noisy or inaccurate measurements.
Identify meaningful deviations from individual health baselines.
Protect continuous health and activity data through secure processing and storage.
Clearly distinguish wellness recommendations from situations requiring professional medical evaluation.

PS-CS01.punch: Aahaa... Ivanukku theriyum nu nenaikaran! Link-ah click panniduvaenaa?!
constraints: Analyze emails and URLs within 2 seconds.
Detect previously unseen phishing techniques and suspicious URL patterns.
Minimize the incorrect flagging of legitimate emails and websites (low false positive rate).
Identify shortened URLs, URL redirection chains, encoded links, and lookalike domains.
Analyze email content securely without unnecessarily storing or leaking sensitive data.
Highlight suspicious indicators and explain why a message is considered malicious.

PS-CS02.punch: Password '123456'-ah vechikitu hackers kitta mass kaatna epdi thala?!
constraints: Evaluate password strength and entropy within 1 second.
Never store, log, or transmit raw passwords in plain text during analysis.
Identify common dictionary passwords, predictable sequences, and keyboard patterns.
Check against known compromised-password datasets securely using k-anonymity or hashing.
Estimate resistance against brute-force and dictionary-based cracking attacks.
Recommend actionable improvements without suggesting predictable substitutions.

PS-CS03.punch: Neenga enga irundhu login panreenga? London-la irundhaa?! Dei naan madurai-la iruken da!
constraints: Identify suspicious logins and compute risk scores within 2 seconds.
Minimize false alarms and prevent unnecessary account lockouts for genuine users.
Detect impossible travel velocity, suspicious IP changes, and device fingerprint anomalies.
Protect sensitive user activity logs through privacy-preserving hashing and encryption.
Trigger contextual step-up authentication (MFA/OTP) based on computed login risk scores.
Provide clear, interpretable audit logs explaining why a login attempt was flagged.

PS-AI01.punch: Idhu enna resume-ah illa Mahabharatham kadhaya?! Short-ah podunga da!
constraints: Extract structured skills, experience, and education from heterogeneous resume formats (PDF, DOCX).
Support semantic skill matching and identify candidate skill gaps against job criteria.
Generate explainable candidate match scores with transparent breakdown and reasoning.
Prevent demographic and protected-attribute bias in candidate scoring and ranking.
Detect duplicate profiles and overlapping applications across job postings.
Generate role-specific technical and behavioral interview questions tailored to identified skill gaps.

PS-AI02.punch: Document 500 page irukku... Summary 5 varila venum! Mudiyuma mudiyadha?!
constraints: Extract accurate text from scanned documents and images using OCR while preserving layout structure.
Generate faithful summaries and key insights without fabricating facts or hallucinating numeric metrics.
Construct a knowledge graph linking entities (people, organizations, tasks, deadlines, decisions).
Discover cross-document relationships and identify dependency bottlenecks between tasks.
Flag project risks originating from overdue deadlines and conflicting dependencies.
Link every extracted action item to its exact source passage with an assigned owner and deadline.

PS-AI03.punch: Kelvi ketta badhil varanum! Adha vittutu katha katha pesina naan emathiruvena?!
constraints: Run the SLM, embeddings, indexing, and inference completely locally via Ollama without cloud AI APIs.
Store document embeddings locally using vector databases like FAISS, ChromaDB, or LanceDB.
Support hybrid keyword (BM25) and semantic vector search across indexed documents.
Provide accurate source citations (page & snippet) for every generated answer.
Gracefully refuse to hallucinate and state when context is insufficient to answer.
Operate fully offline with zero data leakage beyond the local host machine.

PS-SU01.punch: Current bill-ah paathu shock aagadha... AC-ah 24-la vai da modhalla!
constraints: Ingest CSV, simulated smart-meter, and time-series data using efficient data-processing workflows.
Identify high-consumption areas, usage patterns, and anomalies without confusing normal seasonal variation with faults.
Provide a what-if simulator for appliance and usage changes with projected monthly kWh and cost savings.
Calculate bills using versioned state tariff slabs and appliance reference data such as BEE star ratings.
Use forecasting and clustering outputs to produce explainable, actionable energy-reduction recommendations.
Present interactive charts and comparisons in a responsive dashboard suitable for hackathon demonstration.

PS-SU02.punch: Idhu dry waste-ah wet waste-ah nu theriyama dustbin kooda sanda podadheenga!
constraints: Detect multiple waste items in one image and classify each as biodegradable, recyclable, hazardous, or non-recyclable.
Provide reliable predictions across varied lighting, backgrounds, object overlap, contamination, and crushed items.
Map every detected category to clear disposal or recycling guidance rather than relying on an unexplained label.
Show nearby scrap dealers, recycling centres, and collection drives using a map and available location data.
Estimate waste weight, scrap value, and recycling value using transparent reference rates and uncertainty ranges.
Support practical image upload or camera capture with responsive bounding-box results and efficient inference.

PS-SU03.punch: Bike-laye poi poi carbon footprint Everest range-ku poiruchu! Konjam nadanthu po da!
constraints: Calculate transport, electricity, food, shopping, and lifestyle emissions using versioned IPCC, DEFRA, or India CEA factors.
Maintain a user digital twin containing profile, habits, assets, and activity assumptions with clear edit controls.
Simulate alternative habits and transport choices with projected six-to-twelve-month emissions and savings.
Represent uncertainty in user inputs and emission factors rather than presenting unsupported precision.
Rank personalized recommendations by estimated environmental impact and implementation effort.
Protect location, habit, and activity data through privacy-first processing and secure local storage.

PS-ES01.punch: Sir enna solreenga?! Onnum puriyala! Konjam Tamil-la sollu pa!
constraints: Explain academic concepts at an appropriate learner level using trusted course content and retrieval.
Provide source citations and a structured rationale explaining why an explanation or example was selected.
Detect hidden prerequisite gaps through diagnostic questions, concept dependencies, and mastery tracking.
Generate adaptive MCQ and short-answer quizzes with strict answer validation and difficulty adjustment.
Identify likely misconceptions and provide targeted hints without replacing the learner's reasoning.
Deliver a responsive chat experience with streaming responses and privacy-conscious student data handling.

PS-ES02.punch: Arrear vantha piragu kavalai pattu enna labam? Modhallaye therincha pass aagidalamla!
constraints: Combine attendance, assessments, assignments, and learning progress into an auditable student-risk score.
Represent Student, Course, Concept, Assessment, and Intervention relationships in a queryable knowledge graph.
Provide global and per-student explanations for risk predictions using plain-language feature contributions.
Identify concept-level weaknesses and recommend targeted interventions with measurable follow-up actions.
Minimize bias and false alarms, and never treat a risk score as a definitive judgment about a student.
Protect student records with role-based access controls and provide a teacher dashboard for drill-down and intervention tracking.

PS-ES03.punch: Kadhai kekka ellarukum aasa dhaan... Aana ellarukum puriyura maadhiri sollanumla!
constraints: Extract text and structure from PDFs, scans, images, diagrams, charts, and flowcharts using OCR and multimodal processing.
Simplify content to a selected reading level while preserving definitions, equations, relationships, and essential meaning.
Convert content into accurate audio and multiple languages, preserving technical terms and mathematical context.
Provide explainable output with source bounding boxes, confidence scores, and original-versus-simplified comparisons.
Meet WCAG 2.2 AA expectations with screen-reader support, keyboard navigation, high contrast, and dyslexia-friendly presentation.
Support low-bandwidth access and graceful handling of OCR, translation, or multimodal extraction uncertainty.

PS-OI01.punch: Token number 45-ku innum 3 mani neram aaguma?! Token vangitu biryani saaptu vandhuralam!
constraints: Dynamically estimate wait times adapting to live counter service throughput and delay spikes.
Deliver live queue updates to connected clients within 500ms using WebSockets or SSE.
Prevent token scalping and fraudulent bulk bookings using device fingerprinting and rate limits.
Provide SMS or push notification alerts when a user's token is approaching front of queue.
Include administrative overrides for priority, emergency, or cancelled ticket situations.
Ensure zero downtime and seamless state recovery during sudden peak rush traffic.

PS-OI02.punch: Road-la pallam irundha photo eduthu podu da... Facebook-la illa, indha app-la!
constraints: Enforce verified GPS geo-tagging and reverse-geocoding for every submitted issue report.
Detect duplicate reports within a geographic radius using spatial clustering and image comparison.
Automatically route submitted issues to the responsible municipal department based on category.
Provide a public transparency dashboard with real-time status badges and resolution SLA timelines.
Include image compression and offline-first queueing for low mobile connectivity zones.
Protect citizen privacy by automatically blurring faces and vehicle license plates.

PS-OI03.punch: Meeting mudinjuruchu... Aana yaar enna pannanum nu yaarukume theriyala! Typical!
constraints: Accurately differentiate and attribute speaking turns across distinct meeting participants.
Generate concise summaries highlighting major decisions, debate outcomes, and meeting conclusions.
Extract actionable tasks mandating an explicit owner, clear deliverable, and target completion date.
Filter out conversational filler, small talk, and repetitive banter from actionable takeaways.
Seamlessly export extracted action items to project management tools (Jira, Trello, Calendar).
Ensure meeting recordings and sensitive corporate discussions are encrypted at rest and in transit.
